title: Authoring skill: line-item add paths must set or compute the amount, and a persona's create policy must not need values the user never says
body:
eval#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzr7AespGQoymAnLtn

Filed by eval#1 (#33468) from the classification on #33973 (requested by repo:cloud#5).

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed (#33973: 「聊天里改数据 出问题的关键还是我们的skills需要优化吧？」 and its acceptance "each class with at least two failures has a card filed").

## Why (business)

20 of the 121 failed in-chat writes in the 2026-11-15 runs (#33920) trace to how the AI built the app, which the authoring skills steer. Fixing the guidance helps every model that builds, including the hosted one.

## What the runs show

1. **Line items with no way to set the amount** (6, haiku and opus): the built app's add-line action takes `invoice`, `product`, `quantity` but no price, and the price field is not writable or readable for the sales persona, so a line the user asked for at a stated amount is written with amount 0. The agent reports it ("the add-line action doesn't let me set a price"). Guidance: a line-item add path either takes the amount (or unit price) as a parameter the persona may set, or computes it from a source the build declares (for example a product price), never leaves it 0.
2. **Create policy needs a value the user never says** (14, haiku builds only, none from opus): the contractor asks "Add a 'Launch checklist' task to the Website relaunch."; the build's policy refuses the create with 403 unless a field the ask does not name is set (the card's expected row also carries an assignee). Guidance: when a persona may create only rows tied to them, default that field to the current user (or document it in the field's description so an agent sets it), so a plain request succeeds.

## Where

The published authoring skills under `skills/` (the line-items and permissions guidance); the skills lane owns the exact files. A sibling authoring card from the same runs: #33819 (mask a roll-up over a child the persona may not read).

## Acceptance

- The guidance names both rules with a short example each.
- The next eval-run round shows no `add_line` amount-0 writes and no create 403 on `add_task` from haiku builds, or the record says why.
